# SolarMatch Thailand

SolarMatch Thailand is a bilingual prototype that helps homeowners understand a possible rooftop-solar system-size and savings range before speaking with an installer.

Canonical public routes:
- Thai home: https://solarmatch-thailand.deluxejahseh.workers.dev/
- English home: https://solarmatch-thailand.deluxejahseh.workers.dev/en
- Thai estimator: https://solarmatch-thailand.deluxejahseh.workers.dev/estimate
- English estimator: https://solarmatch-thailand.deluxejahseh.workers.dev/en/estimate
- Thai methodology: https://solarmatch-thailand.deluxejahseh.workers.dev/methodology
- English methodology: https://solarmatch-thailand.deluxejahseh.workers.dev/en/methodology
- Thai resources: https://solarmatch-thailand.deluxejahseh.workers.dev/resources
- English resources: https://solarmatch-thailand.deluxejahseh.workers.dev/en/resources

Prototype limitations:
- Results are educational estimates, not engineering designs, quotations, or guarantees.
- Current assumptions are versioned and may change after buyer and market validation.
- Surplus-purchase income and tax relief are conditional and excluded from base headline results.
- The contact form validates locally and discards the values; it does not store or transmit a lead.
- There is no live installer matching, payment, advertising, analytics, CRM, LINE, email, OTP, or database integration.
- The website is marked noindex while validation continues.

This file is descriptive only. It is not an access-control or security policy.
